Subject: Acme POC - evaluation methodology & success criteria (post-call recap)

Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before kicking off the trial: 

POC goal (what success looks like)
- Primary: Demonstrate 95%+ intent-classification accuracy for user support queries in scope with average inference latency <= 350ms at target concurrency.
- Secondary: Keep hallucination rate < 2% on top-3 answers; identify failure modes and mitigation.

Scope and datasets
- Start with the 10k anonymized support tickets you shared (scope: billing & account management).
- Offline eval: run our eval harness on 2k holdout examples you flagged as high-priority.
- Online shadow: 2-week shadow period on a 5% traffic slice once offline looks green.

Evaluation methodology options (we discussed both)
- Offline evals: deterministic, faster to iterate; we can run multiple model/quantization variants and produce a graded CSV with metrics (accuracy, F1, hallucination flag).
- Online shadow: runs against live traffic to measure real-world latency, throughput, and user-impact metrics (NPS proxies); useful to validate production behavior.

Proposed grading rubric (initial suggestion)
- Accuracy (intent classification): Pass >= 95%, Warning 90-95%, Fail < 90%
- Latency (p95): Pass <= 350ms, Warning 350-500ms, Fail > 500ms
- Hallucination rate: Pass < 2%, Warning 2-5%, Fail > 5%
- Operational stability: No more than 2 incidents during shadow (incident = >5% error rate for >5 minutes)

Timeline & ownership
- Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria and data access (Owner: Acme / Priya)
- Week 1: Redwood will run offline evaluations and return results + recommended model/configs (Owner: Dylan)
- Week 2: Adjust prompts/configs; start 2-week online shadow if offline passes (Owner: Acme + Redwood ops)
- Week 4: Review shadow results and decide go/no-go (Owner: Marissa + Jared)

Attachments: I attached an evaluation template (Acme-POC-eval-template.xlsx) that maps metrics to sample prompts and expected outputs.

Next steps / asks:
1) Priya — confirm data transfer timeline & any PII/redaction requirements by EOD Friday.
2) Jared — confirm the 5% traffic slice for shadow and expected start date for Week 2.
3) Redwood (Dylan) — start offline eval run once we get the sanitized dataset.

Happy to jump on a quick 30-min follow-up if helpful — propose Tue 4/20 10am PT.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Acme POC - evaluation methodology & success criteria

Hi Jared / Priya — answering your questions and adding operational detail so we can lock the plan: 

1) Hallucination measurement (offline)
- Our offline eval uses a hybrid approach: we first compare generated responses to ground-truth answers where available (automatic string/semantic match + token-level overlap), and mark mismatches as candidates.
- Candidates are then filtered by heuristic rules (e.g., answer contains factual assertion outside context).
- Final step: human raters (internal Redwood QA team) label the candidate set. For 2k holdout samples we expect ~8-12 hours of human review to get high-quality hallucination labels. We report hallucination rate as (# labeled hallucinations) / (# evaluated examples).

2) Latency measurement
- The 350ms p95 target is measured end-to-end from Redwood's public endpoint to model response (does not include additional network hops inside Acme infra). If you plan to run Private/VPC deployment we will provide a separate network baseline test during Week 1 so we can set a final SLO that includes your network latency.

3) Shadow duration flexibility
- We can support a 1-week shadow if offline accuracy >= 97% and hallucination <1.5%. Otherwise we recommend the full 2-week shadow to capture weekend/edge-case traffic. We'll include automatic alerts for degradations so you can stop the shadow early if needed.

4) Grading rubric (operationalized) — proposed columns in the attached template:
- sample_id, input_text, expected_label, model_label, correct_boolean, latency_ms, hallucination_boolean, reviewer_notes, pass_fail_flag
- Aggregate pass criteria: at least 95% correct_boolean AND p95 latency <= 350ms AND hallucination_rate < 2%

Next steps (action items):
- Priya: send sanitized dataset by Mon 4/19 (Owner: Acme)
- Redwood (Dylan): run baseline offline eval and share results by Fri 4/23
- Marissa / Jared: plan shadow start date after baseline review (tentative Week 2)

I'll run the initial offline job as soon as we have the data. Ping me if you want the raw evaluation CSV earlier.

Thanks,
